limitations: Historical synthetic/model calibration only; no new scientific adjudication or nature-level inference.

legacy.claim: At the R1 baseline sample size and cap, the predeclared primary bias statistic B_i detects an injected acceleration-dependent v-tilde offset of amplitude 0.05 or 0.10 (restricted to the two lowest g_N bins) with power >= 80% across the seed ladder, establishing the protocol's minimum-detectable-effect floor at or below the literature-contested anomaly scale.
legacy.kill: Power below 80% at injected amplitude 0.10 (the larger arm) — the protocol's decision rule cannot reliably detect an effect at the scale of the literature disagreement, so a clean R1 null would not be informative.
